items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I knew Fred. Fred Anderson and Billy Brimfield.

ctx.x: Oh yeah! I knew Fred. Fred Anderson and Billy Brimfield. Both of those guys… I think I heard them both. Billy I played with a little bit. Is Billy still around?
I don’t know, but Fred passed recently.
Yeah, because he had The Velvet Lounge.
